blockers.missing_evidence: Named qualified people for the mapper, NIST AI RMF subject-matter, ESAF specification and mapping, publication-rights, security and overclaiming, and owner-authorized approval roles, with independence and attributable exact-SHA review evidence.
blockers.owner: ESAF Project Maintainer and review coordinator
blockers.reconsideration_trigger: Qualified named people accept the closed role, independence, access-attestation, exact-candidate, and findings-disposition contract.
blockers.reentry_test: The readiness evidence names every required person, verifies qualifications and independence, and proves attributable exact-SHA inventory/specification and security/overclaiming reviews with no open Critical or Important findings.

gates.rationale: Pinned NIST.AI.100-1 / AI RMF 1.0 public PDF identity, DOI, landing URL, publication date, byte length, SHA-256, and page count.
The official English AI RMF 1.0 PDF is publicly available without a protected interstitial; digests and page count are recorded without committing PDF bytes.
Independent rights review records PASS for all six ESAF-1600 mapping field classes under U.S. government work and NIST technical-series practice.
A complete 72-subcategory identifier inventory is published with a canonical digest derived from the public PDF.
Public subcategory outcomes can be compared with exact ESAF normative text; a positive directional feasibility probe is recorded in the design without creating mapping artifacts.
Existing ESAF-1600 direction, relationship, negative-disposition, rights, evidence, and lifecycle controls can represent a future NIST AI RMF mapping without a parallel schema.
Named qualified mapper and independent exact-candidate reviewers are not evidenced.
HOLD boundary, explicit nonclaims, exact directional question, and future independent security review requirements can be enforced mechanically.

mapping_contract.directional_question: Does exact normative ESAF control requirement text directly support, partially support, or establish a prerequisite for the outcome required by one authorized, publishable NIST AI RMF 1.0 Core subcategory identifier, with each relationship's conditions, expected evidence, and known gaps recorded independently, without implying NIST AI RMF compliance, assessment, equivalence, certification, authorization, or endorsement?

nonclaims: No NIST AI RMF mapping relationship, negative disposition, snapshot, lifecycle record, registry record, or generated catalog entry exists.
No NIST approval, endorsement, certification, assessment, equivalence, compliance, or assurance is claimed.
No coverage statistic or percentage is calculated.
No decision is made for the excluded external_to_esaf direction.
This HOLD does not close Issues #55 or #60.
Official PDF bytes were retrieved for digest verification only and are not committed to the repository.
reconsideration_sequence: Name the qualified mapper, independent reviewers, review coordinator, and owner-authorized approver with required access attestations.
Complete attributable exact-SHA inventory/specification and security/overclaiming reviews with no open Critical or Important findings.
Refresh source identity and rights evidence if NIST revises the publication, and derive GO only if every gate passes with no blockers.

reviewer_contract.approver: An approver authorized by the ESAF project owner

reviewers.qualification: owner-approved NIST AI RMF subject-matter reviewer
independent ESAF specification and mapping reviewer
